propositions: DC transport forwards empty-string assignee verbatim to pycontribs without routing through unassign, causing arbitrary user assignment or error instead of unassigning
pycontribs/jira requires None (not empty string) as the unassign sentinel; empty string falls through to search_users which raises JIRAError or assigns first search hit
Cloud transport already has the fix (routes empty/None through unassign_issue), but DC transport never received its half of the implementation
Empty assignee from outbound_differ reaches DC client.update_issue as empty string via _OUTBOUND_BATCH_ALLOWLIST, bypassing any empty-value guard
DC _assign must map falsy assignee to None before calling assign_issue to match Cloud behavior and unassign correctly
